companyDescription: AI GPUs · CUDA — Dominant data-center AI compute + CUDA software moat. The 'picks & shovels' of the AI build-out.
priceNote: fwd P/E ~19 — ต่ำผิดปกติเทียบการเติบโต หลังกำไรไล่ทันราคา
summary: NVIDIA is the AI-compute monopoly with the CUDA software moat, ~70%+ gross margins and explosive FCF. After earnings caught up to the price, the forward P/E sits near ~19 — strikingly low for the growth — which the DCA model rewards. Slightly higher Fed/semis-cycle sensitivity keeps it just behind the mega-cap anchors, but it screens as a high-quality, attractively valued core add.

catalysts.name: Data-center AI compute cycle
catalysts.description: Successive GPU platform ramps + CUDA lock-in drive multi-year compute demand — structural build-out, not a single date.

risks: Semiconductor / AI-capex cyclicality — sharper drawdowns than peers
Export controls / geopolitics on advanced chips

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Long-duration, high-beta growth — more rate- and risk-sentiment sensitive than software peers.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Pricing power is strong, but the stock trades on liquidity/risk appetite.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Semis are cyclical; a capex pause hits NVDA harder and faster than the rest of the list.
macroRisk.summary: Medium Fed sensitivity — quality is elite but expect deeper drawdowns; size accordingly within a DCA core.

valuationBand.basis: fwd P/E ~19 vs growth; consensus average target ~$299 (range $250–300)

qualityScore.note: CUDA + GPU dominance, ~70%+ gross margin, enormous FCF, net cash — only cyclicality dents the profile.

dcaPlan.note: DCA monthly but size smaller than the anchors — higher volatility; let cyclical dips do the work.

technicalNote.note: Above a rising 200-DMA in mid-2026, but high beta — expect larger swings around the trend.

thesisBreak: CUDA moat erodes / hyperscalers shift decisively to in-house ASICs
Structural data-center capex downturn rather than a pause

stopLoss.rrNote: DCA exits on thesis-break, not a daily stop

entryStrategy.verdict: Elite AI-compute monopoly at ~19x forward — DCA at a smaller weight; lean into cyclical dips.
